remaining_groups: Other existing sample003/004/005 exposures: stress checks only, no exposure reselection.

hard_constraints: each added board component contains an actual strict strong seed
no added pixels adjacent to protected components
selection_before_hold_checks.known_path_floor_reason: Retain at least 60% of the 66-to-148 incremental approximate-path support; ceil(66+0.60*82)=116. This is an engineering preference, not recall.
selection_before_hold_checks.anchor_definition: Seed12, area>=3, span>=10, local line fraction>=0.6, width proxy<=5; unlabeled conservative line-like supplement, not ground truth.
selection_before_hold_checks.risk_proxy: Added component is compact_or_fragmentary if area<6 OR skeleton span<6 OR local line fraction<0.5. This is not a false-positive label.
ranking: minimum compact_or_fragmentary component count per board megapixel, equally averaged across physical boards
minimum compact_or_fragmentary area per board megapixel
minimum total added area per board megapixel
selection_before_hold_checks.fallback: If no config qualifies, retain Pareto alternatives and report no selected config rather than silently relax constraints.

limits: All data development; only three physical boards
Same-board additional poses are not independent tests
No background truth: no precision, FPR, calibrated confidence or global optimality claim
Known004 hand path may be used for developmental parameter selection; inference must never read it
Original6/20 broadening relative to8/20 is protected and not reversed
